views.markdown:
- Restore the compact auto-lock tile corner radius to 0.22 while keeping the expanded menu corner radius at 0.12.
- Update the unselected clock-accent glyph from the latest SVG, including the revised lower-right lock position.
- Re-render the updated SVG glyphs with a transparent background so both lock and clock components display correctly in Control Center.
- Reduce the auto-lock glyph display size by 30% to better match the Control Center tile proportions.
- Further reduce the glyph display size to 50pt for a balanced 1×1 Control Center tile appearance.
- Restore complete SVG canvas centering for the auto-lock glyph; the lock-and-clock image is centered as a whole.
- Use the supplied complete off/on tile SVGs to keep the platter background and icon state synchronized.
- Remove the opaque conversion matte from the tile corners so the unselected tile has no white border.
- Use transparent SVG-derived glyphs only, allowing the unselected auto-lock tile to use the same system platter treatment as Smart Home.
- Restore the white selected platter behind the blue SVG-derived auto-lock glyph.

- Match selected and unselected tile corner treatment, refine the lock-with-clock stroke weight, and keep the clock badge fully inside the glyph canvas.

- Prevent auto-lock with a disable assertion from SpringBoard's live idle-timer coordinator; reset the control to off after a Respring or reboot.
- Limit auto-lock prevention to five minutes by default. Long press the control to choose 5 minutes, 10 minutes, 30 minutes, or one hour; expiration automatically restores normal auto-lock.
- Explicitly invalidate the idle-timer assertion when prevention is stopped or expires, allowing the normal system timer to resume without an extra reset.
- Restore the selected white compact-tile background and show the active duration with a checkmark in the duration menu.
- Use one custom lock-with-clock glyph for auto-lock prevention: white on the dark tile and system blue on the white selected platter.
- Increase the lock-with-clock glyph size in the compact auto-lock tile.
- Define and implement the lock-with-clock visual specification, with a larger lock body and attached clock badge.
- Match the approved compact-tile mockup by increasing the timed-lock glyph to 56pt.
- Give the selected white auto-lock platter the same adaptive rounded corners as other 1×1 Control Center tiles.
- Refine the compact timed-lock glyph from 56pt to 50pt.
